visibility.title: Shown in the app
visibility.intro: Unlisting takes a story off the students' list immediately. It does not revoke anything — anyone who bought it keeps access and playback keeps working — but it disappears from their list too, so it is a way to retire a story rather than a way to take one down for repairs. Deleting a story here does not remove it either: the built-in stories ship with the app and come back when their draft is gone, so this is the switch that controls the shelves.
visibility.putBack: Put this back on the shelf
visibility.takeOff: Take this off the shelf. Anyone who already owns it keeps access, but it disappears from their list too.
